original_copy: OBS Studio's virtual camera works with every app and guarantees 4K video calls. Start Virtual Camera from the Controls dock to share your scene.
OBS 自动配置向导保证所有电脑直播零卡顿，还能自动选出最优设置。第一次录制前直接开播就行，不需要测试。
audience: 第一次用 OBS 直播的创作者

original_copy: OBS 的工作室模式可以先在预览区调整场景，再切换为直播画面，保证观众永远看不到任何错误。

original_copy: OBS automatically publishes every recording to social platforms. If you record in MKV, use Remux Recordings to prepare an MP4 file.
